WHY: pollCharge runs on every tick, so every tick while a charge is unsettled now issues a fresh submit, creating duplicate charges and double-billing the customer. HOW: do not resubmit on NotReadyError — treat it as pending and re-poll (e.g. return a pending state), and only resubmit on a distinct "charge never received" error.
